006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.IMetapathExpression;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IAssemblyDefinition;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.ISource;
011
012import java.util.List;
013import java.util.function.Supplier;
014
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
016
017public class ModelTargetedConstraints
018    extends AbstractTargetedConstraints<IModelConstrained>
019    implements IFeatureModelConstrained {
020
021  /**
022   * Construct a new set of targeted constraints.
023   *
024   * @param source
025   *          information about the resource the constraints were sources from
026   * @param targets
027   *          a supplier to get the Metapath expressions that can be used to find
028   *          matching targets
029   * @param constraints
030   *          the constraints to apply to matching targets
031   */
032  public ModelTargetedConstraints(
033      @NonNull ISource source,
034      @NonNull Supplier<List<IMetapathExpression>> targets,
035      @NonNull IModelConstrained constraints) {
036    super(source, targets, constraints);
037  }
038
039  /**
040   * Apply the constraints to the provided {@code definition}.
041   * <p>
042   * This will be called when a definition is found that matches the target
043   * expression.
044   *
045   * @param definition
046   *          the definition to apply the constraints to.
047   */
048  protected void applyTo(@NonNull IModelConstrained definition) {
049    applyTo((IValueConstrained) definition);
050    getIndexConstraints().forEach(definition::addConstraint);
051    getUniqueConstraints().forEach(definition::addConstraint);
052    getHasCardinalityConstraints().forEach(definition::addConstraint);
053  }
054
055  @Override
056  public void target(IAssemblyDefinition definition) {
057    applyTo(definition);
058  }
059}
